= {project_name}

image:https://github.com/gesinn-it-pub/mediawiki-extensions-DisplayTitle/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg[CI,link=https://github.com/gesinn-it-pub/mediawiki-extensions-DisplayTitle/actions/workflows/ci.yml]

A MediaWiki extension that allows pages to have a custom display title set via
`{{DISPLAYTITLE:...}}`, and renders that title in links and other page contexts
throughout the wiki.

This is a fork of
https://github.com/wikimedia/mediawiki-extensions-DisplayTitle[wikimedia/mediawiki-extensions-DisplayTitle]
with an additional feature: automatic purging of incoming links when a page's
display title changes, so linked pages always show the up-to-date title without
manual cache invalidation.

== Documentation

For the upstream extension see the
https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:DisplayTitle[MediaWiki extension page].

== Installation

Add the following to `LocalSettings.php`:

[source,php]
----
wfLoadExtension( 'DisplayTitle' );
----
